Maccabi Netanya F.C. is an Israeli professional football club based in Netanya. Established in 1934 in the Palestine League, the club was a founding member of the Israeli League in 1949. After winning their first championship in 1971, the club's golden period lasted until the late 80s, including four more league titles and a double in 1978.
